text:
The service was terrible. The clinic room was nothing like what I expected. I hit the jackpot with an unprofessional dentist and assistant. The only good thing was the polite receptionist. The Facebook page admin was awful; they only took bookings, didn't screen patients, and didn't help solve any problems or provide any assistance. They even blamed the customer. 0/10

I clearly informed them via chat beforehand that I was "undergoing orthodontic treatment and had a referral for tooth extraction," but upon arrival at the clinic, it couldn't be done. The only reason given was, "The dentist is afraid to extract because of the wires in your mouth," which was an unclear explanation and greatly undermined my confidence.

What should have happened was better case screening during the appointment, or at least professional communication. For example, stating that after assessment, due to the braces, they would have a more experienced dentist examine the case, along with an apology for the inconvenience. Instead, I received only the repeated phrase, "Afraid to extract," in a childish tone, as if this were a joke. I understand the dentist might not be experienced enough, but their demeanor was clearly unprofessional; they just kept saying "Afraid to extract" without any explanation, apology, or further clarification.

The on-site management was also inappropriate. The dental assistant had a harsh tone and told me to come back the next day or another day, without considering the patient's time constraints, as many patients need to manage their studies, work, and travel arrangements. This includes us, who had planned for tooth extraction and recovery, but everything was hectic and everyone was busy.

The condition of the treatment room was also unsettling. This is the first clinic that has made me feel this way, even though I thought it would be good, considering they have multiple branches and the pictures looked good. I had a bad feeling from the start, even before the incident occurred. For example, the cleanliness and some equipment seemed untidy. The faucet had tissue and a rubber band stuck in it? The mouthwash cups looked very old. It made me feel uncomfortable and unsure about the clinic's standards.

The coordination through the page admin was also inefficient. It seemed like they only handled booking appointments but didn't screen cases or coordinate appropriately with the branches, even though I had clearly provided case details.

After the problem, I tried to contact them about a refund for the booking fee for more than 3 days because I wasn't happy with the service. If they had been more polite, they would have offered to come on another day. I clearly stated that I wasn't available to answer calls and asked them to communicate via chat, but the admin only replied "received the request" without any progress updates. They kept telling me to wait for calls and tried to get me to come back to the clinic, even though I had already explained that it was inconvenient to travel and that I had already had treatment at another clinic. It's like the admin has memory problems. I don't want to be harsh, but I was very frustrated. Polite conversations turned into angry exchanges in the chat because of your inefficiency.

What's worse is that the reason given was later changed to "not bringing the original referral letter," even though no one mentioned this on the day of service, and I showed them the referral letter file in the format they already provide. This is because the original clinic is far away and I couldn't travel to get the original document. This was also stated in advance.

To be fair, the next day I had my tooth extracted at another clinic using only the referral letter file, and everything went smoothly. The doctor there was much more professional, explained things clearly, and provided much more reassurance to the patient.

In short, the problem isn't with my case, but with the communication, service standards, and management of the clinic itself. I hope this will be improved. I feel terrible and extremely disappointed.
